description: List the effective referrers that apply to a folder using override-total semantics: the folder's own referrers if it has any, otherwise the library-level referrers. Use this to know which domains actually gate playback for videos in the folder. Returns { refers: [{ id, url, type, status, origin: { type, id } }] }. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

folder_id.description: Folder UUID to resolve effective referrers for

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_list_folder_refer_inherited
title: List Folder Effective Domain Referrers
